goal: Restore Property Matches for non-admin Licensing users through the existing Licensing-gated Scraped Properties read surface when the lower-level reconciliation view is refused, without changing database structure, roles, grants, or decision controls.
dispatcher: Albert owner request in Codex task
prohibited_actions: No database migration, role grant, permission broadening, or production data write
Do not weaken or bypass the Licensing Manager gate or append-only decision controls
Do not call the failure fixed without exact deployed-head live workflow evidence
assumptions: The existing db_data_admin_scraped_properties RPC remains the authorized Licensing read surface already used by the adjacent production tab.
The fallback runs only after the direct OPA reconciliation view returns an error and preserves every OPA submission option returned by the authorized review surface.
stop_conditions: Testing shows the main property-match queue RPC itself fails for a correctly linked Licensing user
A complete OPA picker would require broader database permissions or a database structure change
A required test or independent review identifies a capability or authorization regression
